subject.title: fix(telegram): prevent silent misparse of multi-colon delivery targets

question: Should this PR merge with parser-level proof, or should maintainers require live Telegram topic delivery proof or a compatibility carve-out before merge?
rationale: The code path is correct and focused, but only maintainers can confirm whether any shipped or observed extra-colon Telegram target strings must remain compatible despite not being documented.

options.title: Accept Parser Fallback Tradeoff
options.body: Accept that unsupported extra-colon targets now fall back unchanged because documented numeric, username, t.me, and topic forms are preserved by focused tests.

options.title: Request Live Telegram Topic Proof
options.body: Ask for a short Telegram Desktop or bot-to-bot proof showing valid topic targets still deliver correctly before merging.

options.title: Pause For Compatibility Contract
options.body: Pause the PR if maintainers know of a shipped non-t.me extra-colon target contract that needs explicit migration or preservation.

recommendation.title: Accept Parser Fallback Tradeoff
recommendation.body: Accept that unsupported extra-colon targets now fall back unchanged because documented numeric, username, t.me, and topic forms are preserved by focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete introduced the central parser and is the clearest history owner for deciding the malformed-target compatibility boundary.
